description: TCFD Physical Risk Report — generates a Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) physical risk assessment for a commodity portfolio. Maps climate signals from all 11 commodity markets to TCFD physical risk categories (acute and chronic), scores transition risk alignment, and produces a structured report suitable for investor disclosure. Pass portfolio as an array of {symbol, positionUsd}. x402 paid, USDC on Base.

horizon.description: Forecast horizon for risk assessment. Default 90d.

portfolio.description: Array of {symbol: "WHEAT", positionUsd: 500000}. Symbols: WHEAT · CORN · SOYB · COFFEE · COCOA · COTTON · SUGAR · WTI · NG · COPPER · LUMBER.

name: forecast.tcfd_report

disclosure.description: Draft TCFD disclosure narrative for the portfolio.

physicalRisk.description: Acute and chronic physical risk scores per commodity, mapped to TCFD categories.

transitionRisk.description: Policy, technology, market, and reputation transition risk signals.
